purpose: GameXXK body/reading font (non-title text); source files unmodified
selectionReason: User rejected the Cheese Foam Oolong Song body face as too thin and asked for this rounded pop face. Full project-corpus coverage (1799/1799 unique characters) with no fallback needed, and it renders visibly heavier than the Song face at the same size.

files.source: User-provided archive: 荆南圆体(けいなん丸ポップ体)_猫啃网.zip (D:\360Downloads)
licenseEvidence: licenses/KeinannMaruPOP-Readme.pdf states '(KeinannMaruPOP) SIL Open Font License 1.1' with http://scripts.sil.org/OFL and https://licenses.opensource.jp/OFL-1.1/OFL-1.1.html
licenses/maoken-license-note.txt: the Maoken packaging note states the font is free for personal and commercial use
files.derivation: Derived from KNBobohei (Kingnam Type Foundry / NightFurySL2001, https://github.com/maoken-fonts/KNBobohei); Reserved Font Names must not be reused for modified versions.

rejected.reason: Japanese-only subset: missing 542 CJK characters used by the project (专业、丛、东、丝 ...). Not usable for Simplified Chinese UI text.

superseded.reason: User judged the Song body face too thin on 2026-09-12; assets removed from /Game/GameXXK/UI/Fonts/Body after the swap.
